name: Listenetic
shortDescription: Provides a unified API for uploading and managing diverse content types including text, audio, images, and markup formats to the Listenetic platform with Bearer token authentication and specialized handling for SSML and markdown content.

rawRecord.short_description: Provides a unified API for uploading and managing diverse content types including text, audio, images, and markup formats to the Listenetic platform with Bearer token authentication and specialized handling for SSML and markdown content.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: The Listenetic MCP server provides a unified API for uploading and managing content across a wide range of MIME types, with specialized support for text-based formats like SSML, markdown, and plain text, as well as binary formats like audio files and images. Built around three core tools - listing supported MIME types, creating text-based content, and uploading binary content - it uses Bearer token authentication with JWT tokens and integrates seamlessly with the npx mcp-remote CLI utility for terminal-based interactions. Designed for content creators and developers who need to programmatically upload diverse content types to the Listenetic platform, with optimized handling for audio and markup formats that align with Listenetic's content processing capabilities.
